item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find credible 2023 evidence that Putin strengthened independent courts, legislatures, audit bodies, local governments, or oversight institutions in a way that empowered them to constrain him. The available evidence runs the other direction, with only formal procedures and limited reactive complaint handling as weak counterexamples.","evidence":[{"title":"Russia: Freedom in the World 2023 Country Report","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2023","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2023","summary":"Freedom House says the judiciary lacks independence, judges’ careers depend on Kremlin preferences, and the 2020 constitutional amendments strengthened presidential control over the legislature and courts.
